target: macOS Tahoe visual behavior; makOS on Linux

observations.recovery: Dark background, compact centered utility list with four rows, icons on the left, Continue at lower right, menus at the top. The supplied image labels macOS Sequoia.
observations.disk_utility: Dark sidebar with device/volume hierarchy, toolbar actions, capacity badge, storage bar and a two-column detail table. View offers sidebar and device/volume filters. Erase is a modal sheet.
observations.tahoe_installer: Centered large circular operating-system mark, title, short instruction and Continue; a subsequent screen selects the installation destination.
observations.tahoe_first_start: Wallpaper behind a light rounded panel, back navigation, country list or local-account form, Continue at lower right. Screens visually inspected in the browser.

boundaries: These are visual references, not authorization to run their disk-operation instructions.
No Apple account authentication, APFS formatting, or Time Machine compatibility is implemented.
First-start assistant and full installer restyling remain unimplemented.
